'''2013 Match Play Championship Day 1 Justin Carulli DS You Cannot Hide Forever''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Justin Carulli]] at [[2013 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|You Cannot Hide Forever|DS2-D-youcannothideforever.gif|label=You Cannot Hide Forever / Mobilization Points}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
